ImageDescription:
Leontien van Moorsel heads for a solo victory by almost 2 minutes in Stuttgart at the 1991 UCI Road World Championships. The Batavus frame and Campagnolo group set - with Delta brakes - were typical of the equipment used by the top riders in 1991.

Scanned from a 35mm Agfa Ultra 50 negative - not the best for sports action shots!
Credit: 1991 World Road Champion - Leontien van Moorsel
